body:
"Art forms that appeal to modern leftist intellectuals tend to focus on
sordidness, defeat and despair, or else they take an orgiastic tone, throwing
off rational control as if there were no hope of accomplishing
anything through rational calculation and all that was left was to immerse
oneself in the sensations of the moment."

I think TK is making a lot of sense here.  But c'mon, he's gotta cut the young
people some slack.. I wouldn't expect a man his age to relate to metal or punk
rock.   I do, however, recognize the leftist influence in music that TK was
referring to.  Anyhow, I'm sure TK would appreciate any support he receives at
this time -- even from the left wingers in this forum!  

Relatedly, I would love some good far right wing bands to sprout and to mold
the rock 'n' roll lanscape.. (Reading Curt Cobain's "PC" drivel in his
"Incesticide" album DISGUSTS me!) 

Pyro
